items.note: ἠγίασμένοις (ēgiasmenois) 'sanctified' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἠγαπημένοις (ēgapēmenois) 'loved' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
θεόν (theon) 'God' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
τοῦτο (touto) 'this' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of πάντα, (panta) 'everything,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Ἰησοῦς (Iēsous) 'Jesus' occurs in a few manuscripts (NA28+Tyn+SBL) instead of κύριος (kurios) 'Lord' in older manuscripts (NA27+WH+Treg+TR+Byz)
ἐξἐλέγξαι (exelegxai) 'to convince' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of ἐλέγξαι (elegxai) 'to convict' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
ἀσεβεῖς (asebeis) 'ungodly' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ψυχὴν (psuchēn) 'soul' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27)
αὐτῶν (autōn) 'of them' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐλέγχετε (elegchete) 'do rebuke' occurs in a few manuscripts (Tyn+Treg) instead of ἐλεᾶτε (eleate) 'do have mercy on' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH+TR+Byz)
οὓς δὲ ἐλεᾶτε (hous de eleate) 'to others then do show mercy' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
αὐτούς (autous) 'them' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+KJV)
σοφῷ (sophō) 'wise' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν, (dia Iēsou Christou tou kuriou hēmōn) 'through Jesus Christ the Lord of us,' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος (pro pantos tou aiōnos) 'before all the age' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
